roadmap.title: Main story and first-use awards
roadmap.description: Complete the story while fishing, cooking, mounting, using Focus Mode, beginning side missions, and creating a Field Survey. Keep the Palico deployed and start multiplayer progress early.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 systems and side missions
roadmap.description: Unlock investigations and tempered monsters, finish 30 NPC side missions, and let ordinary quest and hunt counters rise while clearing the high-rank story caps.

roadmap.title: Exploration, equipment, and online setup
roadmap.description: Complete Kanya's fishing line, collect the two rare endemic creatures, establish camps, forge high-rarity gear and an Artian weapon, then follow players and begin human multiplayer completions.

roadmap.title: Endgame counters and collections
roadmap.description: Reach HR 100, obtain 10 Rarity 6 special items, finish Palico, tempered, apex, capture, hunt, profile, and multiplayer counters, and accumulate one million zenny.

roadmap.title: Launch-roster crowns and completion
roadmap.description: Use binoculars to identify crown sizes and save promising monsters as investigations. Hunt all 29 launch monsters and finish the 26-species miniature and gold crown sets before claiming Eastward Wings.

achievements.description: Obtained all other awards.
achievements.summary: Earn all 49 other Hunter Profile awards on one character.

guide.context: The completion award reads the in-game Hunter Profile awards on the current save, so awards split between characters do not combine.

steps.text: Earn every other launch achievement on the same character.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment The Desert Trotters.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment The Desert Trotters.

guide.context: This is mandatory Chapter 1 story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete The Desert Trotters.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment Beyond the Deluge.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment Beyond the Deluge.

guide.context: This is mandatory story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete Beyond the Deluge.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment Long-forgotten Flame.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment Long-forgotten Flame.

guide.context: This is mandatory story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete Long-forgotten Flame.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment Monster Hunter.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment Monster Hunter.

guide.context: This is mandatory story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete Monster Hunter.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment New Ecosystems.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment New Ecosystems.

guide.context: This is mandatory high-rank story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete New Ecosystems.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns.

guide.context: This is mandatory high-rank story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns.

achievements.description: Complete the main assignment What Lies Ahead.
achievements.summary: Complete the main assignment What Lies Ahead.

guide.context: This is mandatory high-rank story progress and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete What Lies Ahead.

achievements.description: Complete A World Turned Upside Down and finish the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete A World Turned Upside Down and finish the main story.

guide.context: This is the final launch-story award and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the main assignments and complete A World Turned Upside Down.

achievements.displayName: A True Hunter Is Never Satisfied
achievements.description: Completed 50 quests.
achievements.summary: Complete any 50 quests on one character.

guide.context: Assignments, optional quests, event quests, Field Surveys, and investigations all contribute while their own eligibility conditions are met.

steps.text: Reach the completion screen in 50 quests.

achievements.description: Completed your first investigation.
achievements.summary: Complete one investigation created from a large monster after investigations unlock in Chapter 4.

guide.context: Investigations preserve the target monster and environment for later use, which also makes them useful for saving crown-sized monsters.

steps.text: In Chapter 4 or later, open the map, select a large monster or use Environment Overview, then choose Details > Create Quest.
Save the target as an Investigation and complete that investigation.

achievements.description: Completed your first Field Survey.
achievements.summary: Complete one Field Survey created from a large monster on the map.

guide.context: Field Surveys are available from the beginning and start immediately instead of being stored for later.

steps.text: Open the map, select a large monster or use Environment Overview, then choose Details > Create Quest.
Choose Field Survey and complete the hunt.

achievements.description: Completed your first side mission.
achievements.summary: Complete one NPC side mission.

guide.context: Side missions are NPC requests, not Alma's Optional Quests; most become available during Chapter 4.

steps.text: Accept a side mission from an NPC and complete every listed objective.

achievements.displayName: East to West, A Hunter Never Rests
achievements.description: Completed 30 different side missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 30 different NPC side missions.

guide.context: The Missions & Quests > Mission Info menu lists current side missions and prevents Optional Quests from being mistaken for the required NPC requests.

steps.text: Open Missions & Quests > Mission Info and complete 30 distinct side missions from NPCs.

achievements.description: Successfully fished for the first time.
achievements.summary: Use the Fishing Rod to catch one fish.

guide.context: Kanya at the Scarlet Forest base camp starts the fishing side-mission line and provides the fishing tutorial.

steps.text: Equip the Fishing Rod at a fishing spot, cast near a fish, and reel it in successfully.

achievements.description: Successfully cooked a well-done steak for the first time.
achievements.summary: Use BBQ Grill > Grill Meat with Raw Meat and complete the cooking-and-slicing rhythm minigame.

guide.context: Grill Meat consumes Raw Meat from the field pouch; Grill a Meal is a different command and does not produce a well-done steak.

steps.text: Carry Raw Meat, use the BBQ Grill from the item bar, and choose Grill Meat.
Confirm when the meat is cooked, then slice in rhythm until a well-done steak is awarded.

achievements.displayName: Was It a Meal to Remember?
achievements.description: Cooked over the BBQ Grill for the first time.
achievements.summary: Use BBQ Grill > Grill a Meal once.

guide.context: Grill a Meal consumes a Ration from storage and always satisfies this award; it is separate from the Grill Meat minigame.

steps.text: Use the BBQ Grill from the item bar, choose Grill a Meal, and finish the meal sequence.

achievements.description: Successfully mounted a monster for the first time.
achievements.summary: Mount a large monster and complete the mounted weapon finisher.

guide.context: Only attacks made after a natural ledge jump, from the Seikret's back, or certain Insect Glaive moves build mounting damage.

steps.text: Land repeated jump attacks until the hunter mounts the monster.
Use mounted knife attacks until the weapon-finisher prompt appears, then perform the finisher.

achievements.description: Performed your first successful Sneak Attack.
achievements.summary: Approach an unaware large monster and perform the Sneak Attack prompt.

guide.context: The Ghillie Mantle makes the approach reliable and can be used again after a monster relocates.

steps.text: Equip the Ghillie Mantle if needed, approach the large monster from behind, and press the displayed Sneak Attack prompt.

achievements.description: Landed 50 successful attacks on weak points or wounds in Focus Mode.
achievements.summary: Land 50 Focus Strikes on glowing wounds or weak points.

guide.context: Repeated damage creates a wound, shown by darker orange damage numbers and then a glowing red point in Focus Mode.

steps.text: Attack one body part repeatedly until a wound forms.
Hold Focus Mode, aim at the glowing red wound, and use the weapon's Focus Strike; repeat until 50 strikes have connected.

achievements.description: Catch a Curioshell Crab carrying an Ancient Wyvern Coin with the Capture Net.
achievements.summary: Catch a Curioshell Crab carrying an Ancient Wyvern Coin with the Capture Net.

guide.context: Curioshell Crabs appear in narrow hidden dead ends across several maps, often near safe camps; Alma may say, “Is that creature holding something?” when one is nearby.

steps.text: Search narrow dead ends near camps until a crab holding a coin appears.
Equip the Capture Net and catch the Curioshell Crab; receiving an Ancient Wyvern Coin confirms the correct creature.

achievements.description: Catch a Sandstar in Windward Plains area 11 at night with the Capture Net.
achievements.summary: Catch a Sandstar in Windward Plains area 11 at night with the Capture Net.

guide.context: A Screamer Pod stops the Sandstar from escaping; Echo Feathers pulled from a Baunos with the grappling hook supply the pod.

steps.text: At night, search Windward Plains area 11 near the gathering spots.
Fire a Screamer Pod at the glowing Sandstar, then catch it with the Capture Net.

achievements.description: Caught a giant squid while fishing.
achievements.summary: Catch a Goliath Squid in Scarlet Forest area 17 at night with the Tentacle Jig.

guide.context: The Goliath Squid requires nighttime but not a Downpour. Kanya's fishing side-mission line supplies the Tentacle Jig and teaches the whopper reeling mechanic.

steps.text: Complete Kanya's fishing side-mission line at the Scarlet Forest base camp until she awards the Tentacle Jig.
At night, travel to the large water in Scarlet Forest area 17, equip the Tentacle Jig, and cast beside the broad body of a Goliath Squid.
When the Goliath Squid bites, pull the rod with its movement to tire it, reel during each pause, and land the squid.

achievements.description: Reeled in 30 whoppers while fishing.
achievements.summary: Reel in 30 whopper-class fish with the Fishing Rod.

guide.context: Kanya introduces whoppers during her fourth fishing side mission. Gastronome Tuna commonly appear in the Scarlet Forest area 17 lake during Plenty and are attracted by Tuff Joint Bait.

steps.text: Complete Kanya's first three fishing side missions, then accept her fourth mission to unlock whopper fishing.
Rest for Plenty and evening, travel to the Scarlet Forest area 17 lake, equip Tuff Joint Bait, and cast near a Gastronome Tuna.
When a whopper bites, pull the rod with the fish's movement to tire it, reel during pauses, and repeat the full catch until 30 whopper-class fish have been landed.

achievements.description: Established Pop-up Camps in 10 places.
achievements.summary: Establish Pop-up Camps at 10 discovered camp sites.

guide.context: Suitable sites are announced while exploring near the edges and side routes of each map; a camp must be established, not merely discovered.

steps.text: Explore off the main routes until a suitable Pop-up Camp site is announced.
Establish camps at 10 different sites.

achievements.description: Customized a Pop-up Camp for the first time.
achievements.summary: Customize any established Pop-up Camp once.

guide.context: Customization becomes available after a camp has been established and remains available after the story.

steps.text: Travel to an established Pop-up Camp, open its camp-management options, and save any customization change.

achievements.description: Used the binoculars to spot a gold-crown large monster.
achievements.summary: Use binoculars to identify a gold-crown large monster.

guide.context: The Chapter 2 assignment Pinnacle of the Pack contains a guaranteed gold-crown Alpha Doshaguma and can be joined through SOS after the story.

steps.text: Start or join Pinnacle of the Pack, or locate another gold-crown monster.
Equip binoculars from the item bar and keep the monster centered until the gold-crown notification appears.

achievements.description: Customized your Seikret or changed its decorations for the first time.
achievements.summary: Change the Seikret's appearance or decorations from the tent Appearance Menu.

guide.context: Seikret customization unlocks after Chapter 1-4, A Hunter's Pride. Nona in Kunafa Village activates the feature before it appears in tents.

steps.text: After completing Chapter 1-4, A Hunter's Pride, follow the Seikret Customization map icon in Kunafa Village and speak with Nona.
Enter a tent, open Appearance Menu > Seikret Customization, change one option, and save the new appearance.

achievements.description: Reached Hunter Rank 100.
achievements.summary: Reach Hunter Rank 100 on one character.

guide.context: Hunter Rank is capped during the first three chapters and again at HR 15, 20, and 40. Stored rank points are released after the corresponding story assignments.

steps.text: Clear the story assignments that remove the HR 15, 20, and 40 caps.
Complete quests and hunt monsters until the displayed Hunter Rank reaches 100.

achievements.description: Forged five different pieces of armor with Rarity 7 or higher.
achievements.summary: Forge five different armor pieces at Rarity 7 or higher.

guide.context: Late-game monster materials unlock qualifying armor; five distinct pieces are required.

steps.text: At Gemma's Smithy, forge five different armor pieces whose displayed rarity is 7 or higher.

achievements.description: Forged five different weapons with Rarity 7 or higher.
achievements.summary: Forge five different weapons at Rarity 7 or higher.

guide.context: Upgrading through a normal weapon tree counts. Rarity-7+ Artian weapons are unreliable for distinct-credit tracking, so use five conventional weapons.

steps.text: At Gemma's Smithy, forge or upgrade five different conventional weapons to displayed Rarity 7 or higher.

achievements.description: Completed 100 quests with your Palico deployed.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 quests while the Palico is deployed.

guide.context: The Palico is deployed by default but withdraws when a multiplayer quest reaches three or four hunters, so solo or two-player quests are the reliable route.

steps.text: Keep Palico deployment enabled at camp.
Reach the completion screen in 100 quests while the Palico is present.

achievements.description: Forge one Rarity 8 Artian weapon after unlocking Artian restoration in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Forge one Rarity 8 Artian weapon after unlocking Artian restoration in Chapter 4.

guide.context: Gemma introduces Artian weapons during Chapter 4. Rarity 8 parts come from tempered monsters whose armor materials reach Rarity 7.

steps.text: Progress Chapter 4 until Gemma explains Artian weapon restoration.
Hunt eligible tempered monsters for Rarity 8 Artian parts, then ask Gemma to forge a Rarity 8 Artian weapon.

achievements.description: Possessed 1,000,000 zenny.
achievements.summary: Hold 1,000,000 zenny at one time.

guide.context: This is a current-balance check, not cumulative earnings; selling surplus materials and valuable fish scales can finish the total.

steps.text: Accumulate quest rewards and sales without spending below the target until the displayed balance reaches 1,000,000 zenny.

achievements.description: Obtained 10 different special items of Rarity 6.
achievements.summary: Obtain 10 different Rarity 6 special items from the 11 known options.

guide.context: Previously obtained special items remain credited even if storage shows x0. Environment Overview lists the rare Emergence windows needed for most options.

steps.text: Obtain Wyvernsprout from a Carrion Mushroom that grows on an herbivore corpse during Fallow, and obtain Nightflower Pollen from an Ephemeral Blossom in Windward Plains or Scarlet Forest after an evening rest lets the full moon rise.
During Plenty in Scarlet Forest, gather Queensbloom Pollen from Queen Rafflesia; in Windward Plains, gather Time-honed Wylk Gem from a Wylky Crystal Outcrop.
Use Environment Overview to wait for Great Windward Succulent and Fulgurite Vein Emergences in Windward Plains, then gather Great Windward Aloe and Thundering Fulgurite.
Use Environment Overview to wait for Bountiful Treasure and Colossal Amber Emergences in Scarlet Forest, then gather Bulky Treasure and Eternal Scarlet Amber.

Use Environment Overview to wait for a Giant Hopper Crystal Emergence in Oilwell Basin and a Magnificent Fossil Emergence in Windward Plains, Oilwell Basin, or Ruins of Wyveria, then gather Antimite Mass and Genesis Opal.

achievements.description: Hunted many different large monsters.
achievements.summary: Hunt each of the 29 launch monsters once: Chatacabra, Quematrice, Lala Barina, Congalala, Balahara, Doshaguma, Uth Duna, Rompopolo, Rey Dau, Nerscylla, Hirabami, Ajarakan, Nu Udra, Guardian Doshaguma, Guardian Rathalos, Guardian Ebony Odogaron, Guardian Fulgur Anjanath, Jin Dahaad, Gore Magala, Arkveld, Guardian Arkveld, Zoh Shia, Yian Kut-Ku, Gypceros, Rathian, Rathalos, Gravios, Blangonga, and Xu Wu.

guide.context: The launch award omits later additions Gogmazios, Omega Planetes, Seregios, Lagiacrus, and Mizutsune.

steps.text: Use Info > Large Monster Field Guide to identify any launch monster without a recorded hunt, then complete one hunt for every launch target.

achievements.description: Hunt 50 tempered monsters marked with purple target icons.
achievements.summary: Hunt 50 tempered monsters marked with purple target icons.

guide.context: Tempered monsters unlock during Chapter 4. Frenzied monsters are a separate state and do not advance this counter.

steps.text: Complete quests, Field Surveys, or investigations against purple-marked tempered monsters until 50 hunts are recorded.

achievements.description: Obtained your first miniature crown in the Hunting Log.
achievements.summary: Record one miniature crown in the Hunting Log.

guide.context: Monster sizes are randomized, and captures record crowns just like slays.

steps.text: Hunt or capture size-varying launch monsters until the Hunting Log records a miniature crown.

achievements.description: Obtained a miniature crown for 10 or more monsters in the Hunting Log.
achievements.summary: Record miniature crowns for 10 different size-varying launch monsters.

guide.context: Binoculars identify crown eligibility before a hunt, and Chapter 4 investigations preserve a spotted monster's size.

steps.text: Use binoculars to check monsters, then hunt or capture miniature-crown targets until 10 different species are recorded.

achievements.description: Obtained a miniature crown for many monsters in the Hunting Log.
achievements.summary: Record miniature crowns for all 26 required monsters: Chatacabra, Quematrice, Lala Barina, Congalala, Balahara, Doshaguma, Uth Duna, Rompopolo, Rey Dau, Nerscylla, Hirabami, Ajarakan, Nu Udra, Guardian Doshaguma, Guardian Rathalos, Guardian Ebony Odogaron, Guardian Fulgur Anjanath, Gore Magala, Arkveld, Yian Kut-Ku, Gypceros, Rathian, Rathalos, Gravios, Blangonga, and Xu Wu.

guide.context: Guardian Arkveld, Jin Dahaad, and Zoh Shia have fixed sizes; all title-update monsters are excluded. Saving spotted crowns as investigations lets hunters share them.

steps.text: Use binoculars to inspect launch monsters and create investigations for miniature-crown targets.

Hunt or capture Chatacabra, Quematrice, Lala Barina, Congalala, Balahara, Doshaguma, Uth Duna, Rompopolo, Rey Dau, Nerscylla, Hirabami, Ajarakan, Nu Udra, Guardian Doshaguma, Guardian Rathalos, Guardian Ebony Odogaron, Guardian Fulgur Anjanath, Gore Magala, Arkveld, Yian Kut-Ku, Gypceros, Rathian, Rathalos, Gravios, Blangonga, and Xu Wu until every miniature crown appears in the Hunting Log.

achievements.description: Obtained your first silver crown or higher in the Hunting Log.
achievements.summary: Record one silver crown or better in the Hunting Log.

guide.context: The guaranteed Alpha Doshaguma in Pinnacle of the Pack is a gold-crown target and can satisfy this immediately.

steps.text: Use binoculars on the Alpha Doshaguma in Pinnacle of the Pack, then complete the hunt.

achievements.description: Obtained a gold crown for 10 or more monsters in the Hunting Log.
achievements.summary: Record gold crowns for 10 different size-varying launch monsters.

guide.context: Binoculars identify gold-crown eligibility before a hunt, and Chapter 4 investigations preserve a spotted monster's size.

steps.text: Use binoculars to check monsters, then hunt or capture gold-crown targets until 10 different species are recorded.

achievements.description: Obtained a gold crown for many monsters in the Hunting Log.
achievements.summary: Record gold crowns for all 26 required monsters: Chatacabra, Quematrice, Lala Barina, Congalala, Balahara, Doshaguma, Uth Duna, Rompopolo, Rey Dau, Nerscylla, Hirabami, Ajarakan, Nu Udra, Guardian Doshaguma, Guardian Rathalos, Guardian Ebony Odogaron, Guardian Fulgur Anjanath, Gore Magala, Arkveld, Yian Kut-Ku, Gypceros, Rathian, Rathalos, Gravios, Blangonga, and Xu Wu.

guide.context: Guardian Arkveld, Jin Dahaad, and Zoh Shia have fixed sizes; all title-update monsters are excluded. Saving spotted crowns as investigations lets hunters share them.

steps.text: Use binoculars to inspect launch monsters and create investigations for gold-crown targets.

Hunt or capture Chatacabra, Quematrice, Lala Barina, Congalala, Balahara, Doshaguma, Uth Duna, Rompopolo, Rey Dau, Nerscylla, Hirabami, Ajarakan, Nu Udra, Guardian Doshaguma, Guardian Rathalos, Guardian Ebony Odogaron, Guardian Fulgur Anjanath, Gore Magala, Arkveld, Yian Kut-Ku, Gypceros, Rathian, Rathalos, Gravios, Blangonga, and Xu Wu until every gold crown appears in the Hunting Log.

achievements.description: Captured 50 monsters.
achievements.summary: Capture 50 large monsters with traps and tranquilizers.

guide.context: A capturable monster normally limps and shows a skull beside its minimap icon. Captures also count toward large-monster hunt totals.

steps.text: Reduce a non-elder large monster until it limps or shows the skull icon.
Catch the weakened large monster in a Shock Trap or Pitfall Trap, then apply two Tranq Bombs or two tranquilizer-ammo hits; complete this capture sequence on 50 large monsters.

achievements.description: Hunted 100 large monsters.
achievements.summary: Hunt or capture 100 large monsters.

guide.context: The Large Monster Field Guide's hunted total already includes captures, so captured monsters must not be added a second time.

steps.text: Complete large-monster hunts until Info > Large Monster Field Guide shows 100 total hunts.

achievements.description: Hunt 50 apex predators: Rey Dau, Uth Duna, Nu Udra, or Jin Dahaad.
achievements.summary: Hunt 50 apex predators, counting Jin Dahaad, Nu Udra, Uth Duna, and Rey Dau.

guide.context: Only the four locale apex species count; other difficult or tempered monsters do not substitute.

steps.text: Complete quests, Field Surveys, or investigations against Jin Dahaad, Nu Udra, Uth Duna, and Rey Dau until their combined hunts reach 50.

achievements.description: Completed a quest via multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Complete one quest while at least one other human player is present at objective completion.

guide.context: Support Hunters summoned by SOS are NPCs and do not count. Joining a human player's quest after it begins still counts.

steps.text: Join a lobby, link-member quest, or human player's SOS quest.
Remain with at least one other human player until the quest objective completes.

achievements.description: Completed 100 quests via multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 quests with at least one other human player present at objective completion.

guide.context: Assignments, optional quests, events, Field Surveys, and investigations count. Support Hunter-only completions do not.

steps.text: Use lobby quests, link-member quests, or SOS responses to hunt with another human player.
Remain with at least one other human player through objective completion in 100 quests.

achievements.description: Viewed 30 different Hunter Profiles.
achievements.summary: View 30 different players' Hunter Profiles from the lobby Member List.

guide.context: A Recommended Lobby normally provides enough unique players in one session.

steps.text: Join a Recommended Lobby, open Communication > Member List > Lobby Members, and select a player.
Choose View Hunter Profile for 30 different lobby members.

achievements.description: Followed someone for the first time.
achievements.summary: Follow one player from the lobby Member List.

guide.context: Following is available from the same Communication menu used for Hunter Profiles.

steps.text: Join a lobby, open Communication > Member List > Lobby Members, select another player, and choose Follow.
